turns.prompt_text: how many amps are in a Duracell D battery
turns.response_html:
A standard Duracell D alkaline battery (MN1300) typically provides 12 to 18 amp-hours (Ah) of capacity.

In terms of actual current output:

  • Low drain: It can supply 25 mA for over 600 hours.
  • High drain: It can handle continuous draws of 500 mA to 1 amp, though higher currents will significantly reduce its total capacity and voltage.
  • Max peaks: While it can briefly pulse higher (up to 2 amps), internal resistance typically prevents it from sustaining more than a few amps before overheating or dropping voltage significantly.
